name: I should ask what happens before, during, and after each attack.

label: Ask in your own words
value: You need not meet my eyes. Look down if that feels easier; I am listening.

label: Ask in your own words
value: People like you always make a fuss. Why should I take you seriously?

label: Ask in your own words
value: I spoke cruelly. I am sorry. You deserve to be heard, and I will listen carefully.
